metadata.name: Hourly Aerosol Particle Size Distribution at Neumayer Station, Antarctica (2019)
metadata.description: This dataset contains hourly differential number concentration measurements of atmospheric aerosol particles across 64 size bins, ranging from approximately 93 nm to 4846 nm in diameter. The data was collected at Neumayer Station in Antarctica (70.65°S, 8.25°W) throughout the calendar year 2019. The measurements represent a classic log-normal aerosol size distribution, with peak concentrations in the nucleation and Aitken modes (93–200 nm) and decreasing concentrations toward larger accumulation and coarse modes. The dataset includes 8,754 hourly observations with no missing values, capturing the temporal variability of aerosol number concentrations in a remote, clean Antarctic environment.
